svg.title: rag-cost-curve: What agentic RAG really costs per right answer.
svg.desc: A newspaper clipping. RESEARCH. What agentic RAG really costs per right answer. A measured benchmark of agentic, iterative, reranked and naive RAG on MuSiQue multi-hop questions, metering every LLM call. Agentic RAG: +32.5 exact match, at 2.5x the cost per correct answer. benchmark · MuSiQue · every call metered.
